The day of the Arima Kinen. Spectators 
eagerly anticipating the clash of the 
"BNW" flood the racetrack.

Winning Ticket declared to Narita Taishin 
and Biwa Hayahide that she was going into 
the race fully pumped up.

And... welcomed by cheers that shook the 
ground, they dashed onto the stage of 
battle together.
